name: zmath_project_get_last_screen_scale_xy
description: zMath_Project_GetLastScreenScaleXY returns the cached projection X/Y scale pair.
known_limits: VC5SP3 profile vc5_o2_ob0_md_facs under local manifest zmath_project_get_last_screen_scale_xy verifies the EAX/EDX pair return with zero unmasked byte mismatches after COFF relocation masking.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x472ed0 loads g_zMath_ProjScaleX into EAX and g_zMath_ProjScaleY into EDX with no callees, while the decompiler renders the pair return.
The native projection smoke sets both projection-scale globals and verifies zMath_Project_GetLastScreenScaleXY returns the same X/Y pair before exercising projection batches.
